vocabulary.definition: to draw or draw up again or anew
vocabulary.example: The committee decided to redraw the boundaries of the district.

vocabulary.definition: to divide into parts or portions
vocabulary.example: The powerful nations sought to carve up the territories for their own interests.

vocabulary.definition: a union where two or more states are governed by the same monarch while their boundaries, laws, and interests remain distinct
vocabulary.example: The two countries formed a personal union under a shared royal family.
The artist recreated the famous painting with a modern twist.

vocabulary.definition: the state of not supporting or helping either side in a conflict, disagreement, etc.; impartiality
vocabulary.example: Switzerland's long-standing neutrality has kept it out of many wars.

vocabulary.definition: to acknowledge the existence, validity, or legality of something
vocabulary.example: The international community recognized the newly formed government.
